recognize_zh: 小淋巴球背景中散在具多葉、爆米花樣核的大型 LP 細胞，CD20 與 OCT2 強陽性並有 PD-1 T 細胞環繞；另一區域淋巴竇內有大型淡染組織球並吞入淋巴球（emperipolesis），S100 陽性，兩者並存為罕見的 RDD 合併 NLPBL 複合病灶。
features: Panel A: sheets of small lymphocytes with scattered large cells with multilobated, vesicular popcorn-like nuclei and small nucleoli (LP cells)
Panel B: CD20 highlights LP cells and background small B cells
Panel C: OCT2 strong nuclear staining in scattered large cells at low power
Panel D: PD-1-positive T cells in a patchy distribution corresponding to rosettes
Panel E: large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, round vesicular nuclei and engulfed lymphocytes (emperipolesis)
Panel F: S100 (red)/OCT2 (brown) double stain marking histiocytes (arrows) and scattered LP cells (arrowheads)
describe_en: Lymph node excision shows vague nodular aggregates of small lymphocytes containing scattered large lymphocyte-predominant cells with multilobated, popcorn-like nuclei. The LP cells are CD20 and OCT2 positive and are surrounded by PD-1-positive T-cell rosettes. Separately, sinuses are expanded by large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and emperipolesis, which are S100 positive and also express OCT2. Findings are consistent with a composite lesion of nodular lymphocyte-predominant B-cell (Hodgkin) lymphoma and Rosai-Dorfman-Destombes disease.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a diffuse T-cell and histiocyte-rich background lacking small B-cell nodules and PD-1 rosettes.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15 positive with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/OCT2, unlike LP cells with strong CD20 and OCT2.
Ordinary sinus histiocytes lack emperipolesis and are S100 and cyclin D1 negative.
LCH cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils and express CD1a and langerin, without emperipolesis.

stain: H&E; IHC CD20, OCT2, PD-1; S100/OCT2 double
